summary: OCHA's two vehicle-stoning injury components are being decomposed. The Mar.19 Al-Maarajat attack is already canonical; the remaining Deir Istiya injury is best-supported as Mar.26 but lacks independent exact-event corroboration.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; PLO Negotiations Affairs Department Mar.27 daily report and March monthly report; WAFA for the separate Mar.19 Al-Maarajat component; canonical Sheet dedup audit
resolution_notes: Canonical audit confirms the Mar.19 Al-Maarajat component is already ILPV-2023-0323, based on WAFA plus NAD, and must not be duplicated. For the second component, NAD's Mar.27 daily report covers 08:00 Mar.26–08:00 Mar.27 and places the Deir Istiya stoning at 13:50, which supports Mar.26; its monthly report also dates the same incident Mar.26 and names Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi' of Balata camp as the injured driver taken to a Nablus hospital. No independent exact-event source was recovered, so the remaining Deir Istiya component stays Unresolved rather than being canonically inserted from a single monitoring route.
media_status: No exact media recovered for the Deir Istiya component; no generic, nearby or merely related imagery used.
